meta.brand: The Marcy Lab School — Data Analytics Fellowship
meta.source: Colors extracted from live marcylabschool.org CSS bundle (2026-07-10). Fonts extracted from same source (ABC Diatype, Practice Display) are premium/licensed and are NOT available in Google Slides; substitutes below are free Google Fonts chosen to match weight/vibe.

verified_contrast_pairs._comment: Every pair here is measured (WCAG relative-luminance formula) and passes the stated level. AA-normal requires >=4.5:1, AA-large (>=24px, or >=18.66px/14pt bold) requires >=3:1. Do not introduce a text/background combo that isn't in this table without recomputing.

forest_600_on_cream_200_muted.use: text_on_light_muted role - REQUIRES >=14pt bold or >=18pt regular on bg_card (cream_200); found via accessibility subagent review, current usages (check_understanding/interview_prep band labels) are bold 14pt so compliant, but do not use this role/bg pair at smaller or non-bold sizes

ink_900_on_sage_300_text.use: text/labels on the green callout_styles fill

ink_900_on_gold_300_text.use: text/labels on the gold callout_styles fill

ink_900_on_blue_100_text.use: text/labels on the blue callout_styles fill

ink_900_on_red_100_text.use: text/labels on the red callout_styles fill

blue_900_on_blue_100_marker.use: framework_columns panel marker (large letter/number) on the blue callout_styles fill

cream_50_on_blue_900_text.use: framework_columns anchor panel body text on bg_accent_blue

gold_300_on_blue_900.use: framework_columns anchor panel kicker label on bg_accent_blue - gold_500 measures 4.02 here and FAILS AA normal, use gold_300 instead

do_not_use._comment: Pairs that were checked and FAIL AA at normal text size - kept here so nobody re-tries them.

heading.brand_original_site_font: Practice Display (premium/licensed, not available in Slides)
heading.note: Helvetica is not a Google Font; Slides will substitute (typically Arial, which is metric-compatible) if it isn't available in the viewer's font list. Arial is listed as the explicit fallback for this reason.

body.brand_original_site_font: ABC Diatype (premium/licensed, not available in Slides)

accent.brand_original_site_font: Practice Display (premium/licensed, not available in Slides)
accent.weight: 500 italic for quotes / 400 regular for captions
accent.use: Reserved for quote/critical-thinking slides and image/diagram captions only - a deliberately distinct serif voice so those moments read differently from Helvetica titles/body and Roboto Mono code. This is the same face that was heading/Practice Display's substitute before headings moved to Helvetica; repurposed here rather than dropped.

type_scale_pt._comment: 26pt is an absolute floor across every slide type, with exactly one deliberate exception: source_citation (used only for case_study's caption and answer_reveal's source - real citation/link text, confirmed with the user). body/body_small/caption/code are now the same size - what used to be a size hierarchy (body > body_small > caption) must now come from color/weight/italic instead. title/h1/h2/diagram_label sit above the floor because they were already >=26pt.
type_scale_pt._source_citation_comment: 18pt, not the user's originally-suggested 16pt: answer_reveal renders on bg_card (cream_200), where verified_contrast_pairs' forest_600_on_cream_200_muted (4.49) only clears WCAG AA at large-text sizes (>=18pt regular) - 16pt regular there would be a real new contrast violation. case_study's caption (on cream_100) would have been safe at 16pt on its own, but one shared token stays consistent and both are still clearly 'small print' relative to the 26pt floor.

icon_system.color_rule: tint icons with roles.heading_on_light on light slides, roles.text_on_dark on dark slides; never mix in a differently-styled icon set

callout_styles._comment: Standard style for every drawn card/band/box on a slide (label chips, kicker strips, compare/contrast panels, any future callout): a light-tint fill with a darker same-hue border, 3-5pt weight - never a bare solid fill with no border, and never a fill/border pairing from two unrelated hues. Pick whichever named style fits the box's purpose - don't default to the same one on every slide. Border widths below are chosen to sit inside the 3-5pt range; border_contrast_vs_fill is the WCAG 1.4.11 non-text ratio (target >=3:1 - this is a graphical-boundary check, not a text check, so it's tracked here rather than in verified_contrast_pairs). Text drawn on any of these fills should use roles.text_on_light (ink_900) per the 'mostly black/white text' rule - see BRAND_GUIDELINES.md section 4.

green.use: default/neutral label bands and callouts (check_understanding, interview_prep, answer_reveal)

blue.use: informational asides; one side of a compare/contrast

gold.use: highlight/important-point emphasis (case_study kicker); the other side of a compare/contrast
